phases.name: join
phases.what: spawn wait, stand, sprint, map/inventory/pause/admin menus, admin status and snapshot, earplug key

phases.name: group
phases.what: create a solo group and send a team ping

phases.name: walk_ai
phases.what: walk to police-chernogorsk on foot, wait 30 s, fx_site_patrol_kill once, observe 20 s

phases.name: walk_town
phases.what: walk through a town for signs of life, interiors and doors, then the scavenger street line as a route (stuck ladder: sidestep, back up, open a door, skip once)

phases.name: combat
phases.what: in the town street (walks there first when run alone): take the rifle to the hands, reload with the vanilla quick reload, raise and aim at the nearest visible infected or server AI (never fires; at most 3 targets of 20 s), retreat on foot when wounded

phases.name: loot
phases.what: in the town street (walks there first when run alone): walk to loose ground items in priority order (magazine, ammunition, food, drink, medical, map) and take up to 4 with the vanilla take action; full pockets drop one junk item

phases.name: fixtures
phases.what: setup-only admin fixtures at the spot (fixture=1); the real feature code then runs normally

phases.name: actions
phases.what: real vanilla and HC actions through the client action manager, plus the radio, loot, decay and dead-drop admin commands

phases.name: vehicle
phases.what: the fx_car_side car the actions phase flipped (placed and flipped first when run alone): walk to the driver door, vanilla get-in, start engine, 8 s at half throttle, brake, stop engine and get out

phases.name: walk_zone
phases.what: walk into a zone with guards and an event radius

phases.name: scene
phases.what: walk to a scene chain site, place its scene and read, take and write the notes it leaves

phases.name: forest
phases.what: walk to a woodland barn, run the forage tick, pick forage and stand under the trees for the wind loop

phases.name: survive
phases.what: bandage when bleeding, then drink and eat whatever the town loot and the forage gave, each with the item's own vanilla continuous action

phases.name: mission
phases.what: on foot into a published mission zone from outside (enter zone=mission: in, out and in again until the server's radius receipt arrives)

phases.name: ai_clear
phases.what: bounded foot route to an authored held guard site or police fallback; live requester-attributed and health clears, 120 s post-clear observation, death and one CampRespawn; infected counters excluded as zone-overrun confounds

phases.name: idle
phases.what: stand still; background and time-window counters (125 minutes); DebugSnapshot fires every 300 s

looks.reason: the lighting look is subjective; the counter shows the blend applied, not that it looks right
the colour grade look is subjective; the counter shows the grade applied, not that it looks right
audio is heard, not logged; the sound counter shows a sound was started, not that it is audible or right
sharing a group and its map pins between players needs a second player
a ping appearing for another group member needs a second player
